stage4.notes:
1. 기여 배율은 3000만을 기준딜로 계산합니다. ex)1억 2000만 딜을 낼 수 있는 보스의 경우 3000/12000=0.25의 기여 배율

즉, 3타를 모두 클랜 평균 딜량만큼 넣었을 경우 하루 평균 9000만+, 5일간 4.5억+ 획득 가능

2. 3단계까지는 관통이므로 이월시간을 날리는 만큼 추가 배율이 있습니다.

3. 초월관통을 하면 기여도가 너무 오르기 때문에 공정성을 위해 적정선에서 기여도 조정을 합니다.

4. 4단계 배율은 보스별 상위 10개 평균딜의 95% 값을 기준으로 합니다.

notes: Roster active status is derived from an open-ended source membership period and corroborated by source state o. All other source periods end in a month.
Original roster stores one joined~left period per member, not full rejoin/leave intervals; do not infer undocumented absence periods.
Month counts are inclusive: same-month membership = 1 month. Active cached counts refer to 2026-10 and must be recomputed relative to selected/as-of month.
Original DB says: temporary absences/rejoins may mean actual tenure is shorter; members joining before 2019-11 may be up to four months longer.
Membership exact dates are unavailable. Missing UID remains blank; the numeric nickname 1 is preserved as string 1.
History carries explicit memberCount only when source notes say N인. Do not fabricate 30 for months with no headcount evidence.
2023-06 note is 25인 + 쿨링(노루) 클전: memberCount 25 describes the explicitly recorded count; guest is preserved in note, not silently added.
2026-10 and later DB monthly rows are empty placeholders; no ranks or winners have been invented.

4-stage top10 cells and multipliers are #N/A before October attacks; raw source formulas retained. Source top10 formula does not explicitly filter stage, despite section label stage4, and uses H11:H139/F11:F139 range.
Privacy exclusions: current clan and final login fields are not included in any extracted file.
